event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Mixed tape, energy bid, breadth rotten.
Sept flash PMIs (mfg 57.0 vs 53.6 fc, services 58.7 vs 56.0 fc) landed Sept 23 and beat hard, but only energy and comms monetized it; 177/323 advancers and 25% above the 50-DMA say the index-level flatness hides broad distribution.

INDICES — VIX 15.7, just above its 15.6 20-day MA.
SOXX +0.06%, QQQ -0.01%, SPY -0.08%, IWM -0.09%, DIA -0.31%; large > small by 0.08pp — a statistical tie. Notable cross-asset: USO +2.86% while TLT -1.29% and LQD -0.71%. SPY sits below its 200-DMA on the 45% breadth read — CTA sell-trigger risk is live.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 0.7x, QQQ 0.7x (both below average — no conviction either way); IWM 1.3x and RSP 1.3x gained share, small/mid getting attention, while SOXX and IJR at 0.7x are ignored. Read: flat price on light index volume = drift, not accumulation. Breadth diverges hard — 25% above 50-DMA, 45% above 200-DMA, adv/dec 177/323, up/down volume 0.66, 16 new 60d highs vs 113 lows. Not a narrow mega-cap tape; a broadly weak one.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLC Comms +1.27%, XLV Healthcare +0.63%, XLE Energy +0.37%, XLF Financials -0.02%, XLY Discretionary -0.30%, XLK Technology -0.32%, XLRE Real Estate -0.45%, XLI Industrials -0.75%, XLP Staples -0.89%, XLU Utilities -0.98%, XLB Materials -1.19%.
Top industries: UNG +6.26%, USO +2.86%; bottom: TAN -3.51%, MSOS -4.60%. Flows contradict price at the top — 5d net XLY +$711mm (100p) and XLK +$147mm (60p) inflow, but XLF -$2,305mm (0p) and XLV -$1,089mm (2p) bled hardest despite XLV being today's #2. Money is leaving financials and healthcare while discretionary and comms absorb it; energy's bid is price-led, not flow-led (XLE -$890mm). Rotation state: defensive risk-off with an energy inflation kicker.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.13 and QQQ 1.27 = real protection demand into flat tape; skew positive on both (SPY +3.8%, QQQ +6.3%) = put premium. VIXEQ 39.2 vs VIX 15.7 — a 23.5-point gap = high single-stock dispersion, low implied correlation, rotation tape, not macro-driven.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil +2.86% and nat gas +6.26% with TLT -1.29% is the transmission chain: reflation/inflation impulse lifting commodities and yields, pressuring duration and gold (-0.30%). Next FOMC Oct 28; CME FedWatch shows 100% hike, and Polymarket prices 66% for +25bp (5d +12pp) vs 32% no-change — hike odds are repricing higher.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 52.3, Neutral. Movers: META +4.50%, ALB -4.60%, FDX -4.10%, IJK -0.27%. Best 20d sector XLK +6.49%, worst XLU -9.54%; vol spikes IJK 4.7x on -0.27% (distribution) and UNG 3.4x on +6.26% (accumulation). Watch: IWM -0.09% on 1.3x volume with 20d -5.78% — trend diverges from the light-volume index drift; RSP -0.50% with 20d -5.34% as the equal-weight tell; TLT -1.29% if hike odds keep climbing into Oct 28.
